name: @role-orchestrator/plugin-registry
description: M7-02 controlled plugin/tool extension contracts (DESIGN ONLY - no plugin loader exists in this repository). Defines a versioned plugin manifest (strict semver + sha256 content integrity + closed scope vocabulary + publisher trust claim), a host-side trust inventory (builtin/verified/untrusted, default deny, digest pinning), and ONE pure load-decision function that is the single choke point every future loader must consult per invocation: kill switch and disabled records refuse first, untrusted/unlisted sources refuse, trust-claim escalation refuses, integrity mismatches refuse (against both the manifest digest and the inventory pin), declared scopes outside the host allowlist refuse, and any manifest carrying model/Profile/role/permission/budget/approval-override vocabulary - as keys anywhere in the structure or as permission-skip flag text in any string value (delegating to capability-gate isBlocked) - is rejected before the schema even parses. Scope declarations map 1:1 onto the closed v1 permission vocabulary and capability-gate REQUIRED_CONTROLS as data, and every declared scope is budget-metered (A35): no manifest field can create executions, spawn processes, or bypass DAG quota. Audit events carry ids/digests/reasons only - manifest free text is structurally unreachable (A42/A16: plugin data is never an authorization source).
